hook: Primes with ||alpha p|| small exist in much shorter intervals than before, down to X^(7/12).
summary: The paper shows that for any irrational alpha, short intervals of length X^gamma with gamma above 7/12 contain primes p for which alpha p is very close to an integer, with an asymptotic count. This widens the earlier range of 2/3 to Huxley's classical range for primes in short intervals. The result holds for infinitely many X, not every X, and the allowed closeness exponent is small.
title: Diophantine approximation with prime denominators in short intervals
